stories.title: 'Project Freedom' aimed at wrangling control of Hormuz ends after less than 48 hours
stories.summary: Trump calls off an effort to take control of Strait of Hormuz from Iran, citing progress on talks, but the blockade remains.

stories.title: Indiana primary results show Trump's power over the party
stories.summary: President Trump tried to push out Indiana state senate candidates who rejected his redistricting plan. Tuesday's results are in and he took down most of the incumbents who opposed this plan.

stories.title: Poll: Most Americans say Trump deserves blame for high gas prices
stories.summary: The new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds that 8 in 10 Americans say gas prices are straining their household budgets.

stories.title: A trip to Europe? In this economy? Expensive flights keep vacations closer to home
stories.summary: Expensive airfares are causing Americans to change their travel plans. Travel advisors are seeing a drop in bookings and warn high prices are here to stay.

stories.title: How the 1994 World Cup kicked off America's love affair with soccer
stories.summary: Looking back at the 1994 World Cup in the U.S. and its lasting influence on American soccer.

stories.title: Meet the Tiny Desk Contest finalists: The King Will Come
stories.summary: Tiny Desk Contest judge Bobby Carter introduces us to finalists The King Will Come, a 15-member group based in Utah.
